Initial release of the smyx-facial-hrv-trend-monitoring-analysis skill.

- Enables contact-free heart-rate variability (HRV) monitoring via everyday cameras using remote photoplethysmography (rPPG).
- Computes HRV metrics including SDNN and RMSSD from 30–60s facial videos.
- Tracks daily/weekly HRV trends, with stress and fatigue alerts when HRV drops.
- Supports use cases such as home health, enterprise wellness, physical exam centers, and smart mirrors.
- Enforces strict user identity (open-id) flow for secure history tracking and report queries.
- Provides structured results and history reports in Markdown table format, with direct links to detailed analysis.
